notes: Kinetic Augur (M21): 'When this creature enters, discard up to two cards, then draw that many cards.' The controller chooses which cards (and how many, up to two) to discard (CR 701.8a). With three cards in hand the controller chooses Toss A and Toss B and keeps Keep Me (the lowest-handle card): Keep Me stays in hand, the two chosen go to the graveyard, two cards are drawn (hand 3). Power: two instants/sorceries in the graveyard -> 2.
